title: Mercari Sold Listings Input
description: Pull Mercari sold listings as an eBay-alternative resale comp tracker. No login. Pay per sold listing.

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords to search Mercari's sold-items index. Each query runs as one search. Examples: 'pokemon charizard psa 9', 'nike dunk low panda size 10', 'iphone 13 pro max 256gb'.

minPrice.title: Minimum sold price (USD)
minPrice.description: Drop listings sold below this price.

maxPrice.title: Maximum sold price (USD)
maxPrice.description: Drop listings sold above this price. Zero or empty disables the cap.

maxListingsPerSource.title: Max listings per query
maxListingsPerSource.description: Stop paginating for a given query once this many sold listings have been collected. Higher numbers add latency and proxy cost.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of search pages processed in parallel. Three is a safe default for Mercari.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required at any meaningful volume.
